notes: The *a* of *a fathers house* is placed on the possessor's word, following rule 29's reading that an English possessive expression takes the determiner of the possessor rather than of the head noun.
s009 is the preposition אֵת (H854) by MACULA's tagging, not the object marker, so it aligns to *with* as an ordinary preposition (rule 16's closing sentence).
The article on הַמִּדְיָנִית takes the written *the* here because the ASV renders the phrase definitely, unlike the indefinite rendering at 25.6.
